body: Maybe also if the block flow direction of the viewport changes. That is, if the viewport has the same width as height, and 'writing-mode' changes to an orthogonal writing mode.

When looking at the tests I realized that this ended up "wrong"... Since these properties use the parent's writing mode, but in the prose we use the viewport's writing mode, in the situation where the viewport is vertical but container is horizontal, the prose and the style rules are trying to center on the same axis, but they should be centering on orthogonal axes.

I think best is to change the prose to use dialog's parent's writing mode, to be consistent with these CSS properties.
